notes.title: Demo Update is live!
notes.content: [p]Quick note on what’s new in the [b]Crabby Fishes[/b] demo:[/p][p][/p][p][b]UI & Clarity[/b][/p][list][*][p]Refreshed interface for cleaner visuals[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer in-game messaging and feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Inventory tweaks for better readability and item info[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Game Design[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced waves and enemy pacing[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted tower stats, costs, and ranges[/p][/*][*][p]Tuned Special Power cooldowns & impact[/p][/*][*][p]Smoother early difficulty curve and rewards[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]New enemy units added[/p][/*][*][p]New towers to experiment with[/p][/*][*][p]New Special Powers to shake up your strategies[/p][/*][/list][p]Jump in, give it a spin, and let us know what you think in the Community Hub discussions - your feedback helps us polish the full release![/p]
